page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, resulting in 80 vCPUs without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The server does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated core allocation and high memory density represent a premium hardware class designed for memory-intensive workloads. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable compute performance per vCPU, though the lack of local storage requires factoring in external storage costs. This configuration is suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing workloads.
